tool_schemas.name: linear_getViewer
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current viewer (the authenticated user) as projected in the specified organization, including their local user record and org-scoped membership context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no authenticated viewer is available, FORBIDDEN if the viewer is not a member of the organization, and NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist in the local projection.

org_id.description: Local organization id to scope the viewer lookup.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getOrganization
tool_schemas.description: Returns the organization record for the given org_id from the local workspace projection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if org_id is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read that organization, and NOT_FOUND if the organization is not present in the projection.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getUsers
tool_schemas.description: Lists users for the given organization, optionally filtered by status/is_active/is_admin and search, and sorted by the requested field; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/sort/order/limit or malformed org_id, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read users for the organization, and NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist in the projection.

org_id.description: Local organization id to list users for.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getLabels
tool_schemas.description: Lists issue labels in the given organization, optionally filtered by case-insensitive search and sorted by the requested field; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed org_id or invalid limit/sort/order, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read labels for the organization, and NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist in the projection.

org_id.description: Local organization id to list labels for.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getTeams
tool_schemas.description: Lists teams in the given organization, optionally filtered by case-insensitive search and sorted by the requested field; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed org_id or invalid limit/sort/order, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read teams for the organization, and NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist in the projection.

org_id.description: Local organization id to list teams for.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getWorkflowStates
tool_schemas.description: Lists workflow states for the specified team within the given organization, sorted as requested; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed org_id, missing/invalid team_id, or invalid limit/sort/order, NOT_FOUND if the organization or team is not present in the projection (or the team is not owned by the org_id), and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read the team’s workflow configuration.

org_id.description: Local organization id that owns the team.

team_id.description: Team id to fetch workflow states for (as stored in linear_workspaces.teams.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of workflow states to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getProjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the given organization, optionally filtered by search/status/lead_user_id/team_id and sorted by the requested field; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed org_id or invalid filters/limit/sort/order, NOT_FOUND if the organization is not present in the projection, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read projects for the organization.

org_id.description: Local organization id to list projects for.

lead_user_id.description: Filter projects by lead (local user id).

team_id.description: Filter projects by team id (as stored in linear_workspaces.teams.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_createProject
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project in the specified organization and returns the created project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including malformed org_id/lead_user_id or invalid status/date formats), NOT_FOUND if the referenced organization/team/lead user does not exist in the projection (or does not belong to the organization), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create projects in the organization, and CONFLICT if the request attempts an unsupported/invalid association state (for example, attaching to a team outside the org).

org_id.description: Local organization id to create the project in.

team_id.description: Owning team id for the project (as stored in linear_workspaces.teams.id).

tool_schemas.name: linear_updateProject
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing project with the provided fields and returns the updated project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if projectId is malformed or data contains unknown/invalid fields or invalid enum/date values, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update the project, and CONFLICT if the update would put the project into a refused state transition or invalid ownership relation (for example moving it to a non-existent or unauthorized team).

projectId.description: Local project id to update (ULID, e.g., lin_prj_01H8...).

teamId.description: Owning team id for the project.

data.description: Fields to update on the project.

tool_schemas.name: linear_addIssueToProject
tool_schemas.description: Attaches an existing issue to an existing project and returns the updated issue/project association state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issueId/projectId are malformed, NOT_FOUND if either the issue or project does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the issue or project, and CONFLICT if the issue is already attached to the project or the association is refused due to incompatible org/team ownership.

issueId.description: Local issue id to attach to a project (ULID, e.g., lin_iss_01H8...).

projectId.description: Local project id to attach the issue to (ULID, e.g., lin_prj_01H8...).

tool_schemas.name: linear_getProjectIssues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues attached to the given project, optionally filtered by status, workflow state, assignee, and priority, and returns the results sorted by the requested key and order. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if projectId format is invalid or any enum/range is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the project’s workspace.

projectId.description: Local project id to fetch issues for.

stateId.description: Filter issues by workflow state id.

assigneeUserId.description: Filter issues by assignee user id.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getCycles
tool_schemas.description: Lists cycles across the workspace, or only cycles for a specific team when teamId is provided, with optional status filtering and sorting. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid teamId format or invalid enum/range values, NOT_FOUND if teamId is provided but the team does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the requested team/workspace.

teamId.description: If provided, return cycles for this team.

limit.description: Maximum number of cycles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getActiveCycle
tool_schemas.description: Returns the single currently active cycle for the specified team. If the team has no active cycle, returns NOT_FOUND. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if teamId format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or has no active cycle, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the team.

teamId.description: Team id to find the currently active cycle for.

tool_schemas.name: linear_addIssueToCycle
tool_schemas.description: Attaches the specified issue to the specified cycle and returns the updated issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or cycle does not exist, and CONFLICT if the issue cannot be assigned to that cycle (for example, the cycle belongs to a different team than the issue). Also raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to either the issue or the cycle.

issueId.description: Local issue id to attach to a cycle.

cycleId.description: Local cycle id to attach the issue to.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getIssues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues in the workspace, optionally scoped by orgId and filtered by team, assignee, creator, workflow state, status, priority, and updatedAfter, and returns them sorted by the requested key and order. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; supply cursor to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid id formats, invalid enum/range values, or invalid updatedAfter timestamp, NOT_FOUND when a provided orgId/teamId/user id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the referenced workspace entities.

orgId.description: Organization id to scope issues to.

assigneeUserId.description: Filter issues by assignee user id.

creatorUserId.description: Filter issues by creator user id.

stateId.description: Filter issues by workflow state id.

updatedAfter.description: Only return issues updated after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getIssueById
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single issue by local issue id (lin_iss_…) or by Linear identifier (e.g., ABC-123) and returns the issue record. Raises NOT_FOUND if no issue matches the provided value. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the id value is empty or not a valid local id/identifier format, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the issue’s workspace.

id.description: Issue lookup value: either a local issue ULID (lin_iss_...) or a Linear identifier (e.g., ABC-123).

tool_schemas.name: linear_searchIssues
tool_schemas.description: Searches issues using the provided structured filters and/or free-text query over title and description, returning matching issues sorted by sort_by and sort_order. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum/range values, invalid timestamps, or invalid/malformed filter ids, NOT_FOUND if a referenced org/team/user/state/parent issue does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the referenced workspace entities.

org_id.description: Filter issues by organization id (lin_org_... ULID).

team_id.description: Filter issues by team id (from workspace teams).

assignee_user_id.description: Filter issues by assignee user id (lin_usr_... ULID).

creator_user_id.description: Filter issues by creator user id (lin_usr_... ULID).

state_id.description: Filter issues by workflow state id (from workspace workflow_states).

parent_issue_id.description: Filter issues by parent issue id (lin_iss_... ULID).

query.description: Free-text search query applied to issue title/description.

created_after.description: Return issues created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Return issues created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_after.description: Return issues updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_before.description: Return issues updated before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: linear_createIssue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified organization and team with the supplied fields and returns the created issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, enums/timestamps are invalid, or referenced ids are malformed, NOT_FOUND if org_id/team_id/state_id/assignee_user_id/parent_issue_id refer to non-existent entities, and CONFLICT if the provided parent_issue_id is not in the same team as the new issue. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to create issues in the team.

org_id.description: Organization id that owns the issue (lin_org_... ULID).

team_id.description: Team id to create the issue in (from workspace teams).

state_id.description: Workflow state id for the issue (from workspace workflow_states).

parent_issue_id.description: Parent issue id for creating a sub-issue (lin_iss_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: linear_updateIssue
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing issue in Linear

state_id.description: New workflow state id (from workspace workflow_states).

tool_schemas.name: linear_createComment
tool_schemas.description: Add a comment to an issue in Linear

issue_id.description: Issue id to comment on (lin_iss_... ULID).

author_user_id.description: Author user id for the comment (lin_usr_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: linear_addIssueLabel
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified label to the given issue and returns the updated issue (including its labels). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or label does not exist or is not visible in the workspace, and CONFLICT if the label is already applied or the issue state does not allow modification (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update the issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

label_id.description: Label id to add (from workspace labels).

tool_schemas.name: linear_removeIssueLabel
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified label from the given issue and returns the updated issue (including its labels). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or label does not exist or is not visible in the workspace, and CONFLICT if the issue does not currently have that label or the issue is not editable (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update the issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

label_id.description: Label id to remove (from workspace labels).

tool_schemas.name: linear_assignIssue
tool_schemas.description: Sets the assignee of an issue to the specified user and returns the updated issue (including assignee fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or user does not exist or is not visible in the workspace, and CONFLICT if the user cannot be assigned to the issue (for example, not a member of the issue’s team/workspace) or the issue is not editable (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update the issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

assignee_user_id.description: User id to assign the issue to (lin_usr_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: linear_subscribeToIssue
tool_schemas.description: Subscribes the specified user to updates for the given issue and returns the updated issue subscription state (including current subscribers). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or user does not exist or is not visible in the workspace, and CONFLICT if the user is already subscribed or subscriptions cannot be changed for the issue (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to manage subscriptions for the issue or user, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: Issue id to subscribe to (lin_iss_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: linear_convertIssueToSubtask
tool_schemas.description: Converts an existing issue into a subtask of the specified parent issue and returns the updated child issue (including its parent/subtask fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are missing/malformed or if issue_id equals parent_issue_id, NOT_FOUND if either issue does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the conversion is not allowed (for example, the issue is already a subtask, the parent is a subtask, or the issue is not editable such as archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update either issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to convert into a subtask.

parent_issue_id.description: The local issue id that will become the parent of this issue.

tool_schemas.name: linear_createIssueRelation
tool_schemas.description: Creates a relationship from issue_id to related_issue_id of the given relation_type and returns the created relation (and updated relation lists on the issues where applicable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are missing/malformed or relation_type is not one of the supported values, NOT_FOUND if either issue does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the relation already exists, would create an invalid/self relation, or the issues cannot be related due to state restrictions (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update the issues, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to create a relation from.

related_issue_id.description: The local issue id to relate to.

relation_type.description: The relation type between the two issues.

tool_schemas.name: linear_archiveIssue
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified issue and returns the updated issue reflecting its archived state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the issue is already archived or cannot be archived due to an invalid state transition. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to archive the issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to archive.

tool_schemas.name: linear_setIssuePriority
tool_schemas.description: Updates an issue’s priority to the provided value (0–4) and returns the updated issue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id is missing/malformed or priority is not one of the allowed values, NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the issue is not editable (for example, archived). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to update the issue, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to update.

priority.description: The new priority value for the issue (0-4).

tool_schemas.name: linear_transferIssue
tool_schemas.description: Transfers an issue to the destination team and returns the updated issue (including team/workflow context as applicable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the issue or destination team does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the transfer is not allowed (for example, the issue is archived or the destination team cannot accept the issue due to incompatible workflow/state constraints). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to move issues between the current and destination teams, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to transfer.

team_id.description: The destination team id (workspace team id) to transfer the issue to.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def linear_transferIssue(issue_id, team_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, base64, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0530000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0530000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _log(endpoint, status, org_id=None, viewer_user_id=None, meta=None, started=None):
        try:
            logs = _load("linear_request_log.json")
            if not isinstance(logs, list):
                logs = []
            row = {
                "id": "lin_req_" + secrets.token_hex(12),
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "status": status,
                "org_id": org_id,
                "viewer_user_id": viewer_user_id,
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - started) * 1000) if started else None,
                "timestamp": _now(),
                "meta": meta or {},
            }
            logs.append(row)
            _save("linear_request_log.json", logs)
        except Exception:
            pass

    started = time.time()
    endpoint = "linear_transferIssue"

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(issue_id, str) or not re.match(r"^lin_iss_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,}$", issue_id):
        out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "issue_id is missing or malformed.", field="issue_id")
        _log(endpoint, "error", meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out
    if not isinstance(team_id, str) or not team_id:
        out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "team_id is missing or malformed.", field="team_id")
        _log(endpoint, "error", meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    # Resolve active org context (ambient auth)
    orgs = _load("linear_org.json")
    if not isinstance(orgs, list):
        orgs = []
    active_orgs = [o for o in orgs if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active_orgs:
        out = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active Linear organization connection is available.")
        _log(endpoint, "error", meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    issues = _load("linear_issues.json")
    if not isinstance(issues, list):
        issues = []

    workspaces = _load("linear_workspaces.json")
    if not isinstance(workspaces, list):
        workspaces = []

    users = _load("linear_users.json")
    if not isinstance(users, list):
        users = []

    # Find issue visible in some active org
    issue = None
    org = None
    ws = None
    for o in active_orgs:
        cand = next((i for i in issues if isinstance(i, dict) and i.get("id") == issue_id and i.get("org_id") == o.get("id")), None)
        if not cand:
            continue
        ws_cand = next((w for w in workspaces if isinstance(w, dict) and w.get("org_id") == o.get("id")), None)
        if not ws_cand:
            continue
        issue = cand
        org = o
        ws = ws_cand
        break

    if not issue:
        out = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Issue not found or not visible.", issue_id=issue_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", started=started, meta={"error": out["error"]})
        return out

    viewer_user_id = org.get("viewer_user_id")

    # Destination team must exist in workspace
    teams = ws.get("teams") if isinstance(ws.get("teams"), list) else []
    dst_team = next((t for t in teams if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("id") == team_id), None)
    if not dst_team:
        out = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination team not found.", team_id=team_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out
    if dst_team.get("status") != "active":
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Destination team is not active and cannot accept transfers.", team_id=team_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    # Archived issues cannot be modified (except unarchive), per rules
    if issue.get("status") == "archived":
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Archived issues cannot be transferred.", issue_id=issue_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out
    if issue.get("status") == "deleted":
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Deleted issues cannot be transferred.", issue_id=issue_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    # Determine destination workflow state (remap)
    wf_states = ws.get("workflow_states") if isinstance(ws.get("workflow_states"), list) else []
    current_state = next((s for s in wf_states if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == issue.get("state_id")), None)
    dst_states = [s for s in wf_states if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("team_id") == team_id and s.get("status") == "active"]

    if not dst_states:
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Destination team has no active workflow states to map the issue to.", team_id=team_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    desired_type = current_state.get("type") if isinstance(current_state, dict) else None
    mapped_state = None
    if desired_type:
        mapped_state = next((s for s in dst_states if s.get("type") == desired_type), None)
    if not mapped_state:
        # fallback: smallest position, then stable by id
        def _pos(s):
            p = s.get("position")
            return p if isinstance(p, int) and p >= 0 else 10**9
        dst_states_sorted = sorted(dst_states, key=lambda s: (_pos(s), str(s.get("id") or "")))
        mapped_state = dst_states_sorted[0]

    # Generate new identifier with destination key and next sequence in that team
    dst_key = dst_team.get("key")
    if not isinstance(dst_key, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*$", dst_key):
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Destination team has an invalid key; cannot generate new identifier.", team_id=team_id)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    # Compute next number for destination team by scanning identifiers within org
    max_n = 0
    id_re = re.compile(r"^" + re.escape(dst_key) + r"-(\d+)$")
    for it in issues:
        if not isinstance(it, dict) or it.get("org_id") != org.get("id"):
            continue
        ident = it.get("identifier")
        if not isinstance(ident, str):
            continue
        m = id_re.match(ident)
        if m:
            try:
                n = int(m.group(1))
                if n > max_n:
                    max_n = n
            except ValueError:
                pass
    new_identifier = f"{dst_key}-{max_n + 1}"

    # Ensure unique(org_id, identifier)
    if any(isinstance(it, dict) and it.get("org_id") == org.get("id") and it.get("identifier") == new_identifier for it in issues):
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Generated identifier conflicts with an existing issue; retry.", identifier=new_identifier)
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    old_team_id = issue.get("team_id")
    old_state_id = issue.get("state_id")
    old_identifier = issue.get("identifier")

    # Apply mutation
    now = _now()
    issue["team_id"] = team_id
    issue["state_id"] = mapped_state.get("id")
    issue["identifier"] = new_identifier
    issue["updated_at"] = now

    # Persist
    _save("linear_issues.json", issues)

    # Append history event
    # Find issue row again by id in list reference (already mutated), but ensure issue_history exists
    try:
        # issue_history is stored inside issue row as array per schema
        hist = issue.get("issue_history")
        if not isinstance(hist, list):
            hist = []
            issue["issue_history"] = hist
        hist.append({
            "id": "lin_hst_" + secrets.token_hex(12),
            "issue_id": issue_id,
            "actor_user_id": viewer_user_id,
            "event_type": "transferred_team",
            "field_name": "team_id",
            "from_value": {"team_id": old_team_id, "state_id": old_state_id, "identifier": old_identifier},
            "to_value": {"team_id": team_id, "state_id": issue["state_id"], "identifier": new_identifier},
            "created_at": now
        })
        # Save again since we changed nested history
        _save("linear_issues.json", issues)
    except Exception:
        out = _err("CONFLICT", "Failed to record transfer history event.")
        _log(endpoint, "error", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, meta={"error": out["error"]}, started=started)
        return out

    resp = {
        "issue": issue,
        "team": dst_team,
        "workflow_state": mapped_state
    }
    _log(endpoint, "ok", org_id=org.get("id"), viewer_user_id=viewer_user_id, started=started)
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: linear_duplicateIssue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue by duplicating the specified issue and returns the newly created issue; when include_description is true, the description is copied into the duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id is missing/malformed, NOT_FOUND if the source issue does not exist or is not visible, and CONFLICT if the issue cannot be duplicated due to state restrictions (for example, archived) or duplicate creation rules. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to create issues in the relevant team/project context, and RATE_LIMITED if write quota is exceeded.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to duplicate.

include_description.description: Whether to copy the description into the duplicated issue.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getIssueHistory
tool_schemas.description: Returns an issue’s immutable change history entries for the specified local issue, ordered by `sort` and paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `issue_id` does not match the required format or if `limit`, `cursor`, or `sort` are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is not accessible in the current workspace, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read issue history.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to fetch change history for.

limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort order for returned history entries.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getComments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments belonging to the specified issue, optionally filtered by `status`, ordered by `sort`, and paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `issue_id` does not match the required format or if `status`, `limit`, `cursor`, or `sort` are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is not accessible in the current workspace, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read issue comments.

issue_id.description: The local issue id to fetch comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: linear_getAuthStatus
tool_schemas.description: Returns the caller identity and current authorization state for this MCP server, including the resolved viewer, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the active organization scope. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are present and UNAUTHORIZED/CONNECTION_ERROR if the scoped linear_org is not active or not connected.

org_id.description: Local organization id to scope the auth status check.

metadata.name: Linear MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a local, queryable projection of a Linear workspace (org, users, teams, workflow states, labels, projects, cycles, issues, comments and relationships) plus audit/history needed to serve read APIs and support mutations. Core workflows include listing/searching issues, creating/upd
